data.one_liner: Flutter date picker package designed for web applications.
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable date picker widget displayed as a dropdown for Flutter web applications. Supports single-date or range selection, blocked dates, keyboard navigation, and day events.
use_when: You need a dropdown date picker specifically tailored for Flutter web apps
You require single-date or date range selection with custom styling
You want keyboard navigation support within the date picker grid
avoid_when: You are using standard native mobile pickers and do not need a dropdown style web picker
You need an alternative package already present in your project stack and want to avoid duplicate dependencies
strengths: Supports both single-date and range selection
Includes extensive appearance and behavior customization options
Built-in keyboard navigation support for arrows, page navigation, and enter keys
weaknesses: Relies on external common widgets dependency

alternatives.name: calendar_date_picker2
alternatives.why_pick_it: Alternative date picker package offering customized calendar view configurations.
